rows.text: Notification No. 56/93(6) of 23 July 1993 records that the Commission, 'by its further order dated 22nd July, 1993 has finally decided the said dispute and revoked the above referred interim orders dated 14-1-1993 and 17-1-1993', directing that 'the group represented by Shri S. R. Bommai which was granted interim recognition as Janata Dal (B) is hereby recognised as the Janata Dal, which is a recognised National party', entitled to the symbol 'Chakra (Wheel)'.

locator.section: p. 466, recital of the order of 22 July 1993, directions (1) and (2)

rows.text: The same order withdrew 'the interim recognition granted to the group represented by Shri Ajit Singh as Janata Dal (A)', and the notification adds that 'the group headed by Shri Ajit Singh is, as on date, neither a registered nor a recognised political party'.

The notification of 23 July 1993 substitutes for the entries at serial numbers 5, 5A and 5B of Table I of notification No. 56/92 of 7 January 1993 the single entry '5. Janata Dal Chakra (Wheel) 7, Jantar Mantar Road, New Delhi-110001'.
